 FOX · Aired Yesterday · 13s 
 Watch Now Already a subscriber? Sign-In During the second quarter, Illinois quarterback Katin Houser attempts a pass to the end zone but it is intercepted by UCLA's Aidan Mizell. Mizell secures the touchback, ending the Fighting Illini's drive and celebrating with the home crowd as the Bruins hold their 7-0 lead.
